Caption / description / post text:
This weather not gonna ruin my soup season 😂  This Creamy Sausage Tortellini Soup is loaded with flavor. Like a hug in a bowl. A must try recipe this #soupseason  #sausagetortellinisoup #easyrecipes #whatsfordinner #cooking

Transcript of the video's audio (machine-made):
Hey dad, what's for dinner? Chicago weather just can't seem to make up its mind, but I turn on the AC if I have to, because it's soup season. And this creamy sausage tordellini soup would make you forget that it's 80 degrees outside. Let me show you how I did it. Heat oil in a Dutch oven, then add in your andouille sausage and give them a sear until they develop a nice color. Remove and set to the side, then add in your hot Italian sausage and let it develop a crust and break it up and let it finish cooking. Remove the sausage, then add in diced onions and season with salt and pepper, then saute for a few minutes while scraping the fawn. Add in minced garlic and sun-dried tomatoes and saute until just fragrant. Add in tomato paste and cook until it reaches a deep red, then add in basil, oregano, red pepper flakes, and Italian herb better than bouillon. Let toast for 30 seconds. Then add in flour and cook for about two minutes. Stir in low sodium chicken broth and return both sausages to the pot and let simmer for 10 minutes. Lower the heat and stir in heavy cream and Parmesan. Then add in the tordellini and cook per packet. Just structures. Now fold in the spinach and let this cook until just wilted. Taste and adjust for salt, then stir in a few cubes of cold butter. I topped it with a few pieces of crispy tordellini and due sausage and all the Parmesan that I wanted. Check out the link in my bio for the full recipe. It may not be beef son, but it's definitely was for dinner.
